newsitem.title: USA: Premis files for secondary offering.
newsitem.headline: Premis files for secondary offering.

text.p: Premis Corp said it had filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed public offering of 1.75 million shares of common stock.
The company said in a statement late on Tuesday that all the shares would be be sold by the company. R.J. Steichen & Co of Minneapolis will be the underwriter for the offering.

The company said it intended to use $6.5 million of the net proceeds from the offering for the acquisition of REF Retail Systems Corp of Toronto, pursuant to a purchase agreement entered into on July 9.
The balance of the net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes including working capital.
